en-US.title: English TOEIC · TSL extended vocabulary
en-US.description: Source: Browne, Culligan and Phillips, New General Service List Project, https://www.newgeneralservicelist.com/word-lists (CC BY-SA 4.0). Based on the 1,250 headwords in the TSL 1.2 statistical list, cross-checked and supplemented against the definition file.
